description: Fix the duplicate-navbar bug by consolidating Nav + Header into ONE unified, responsive TopBar rendered once at App level, and update tests to the single-bar structure. This is the structural core of the task; FEAT-002 depends on the .topbar-* classes landing here. Preserves all existing behavior and accessibility.
steps: Create src/components/TopBar.tsx: a single <nav aria-label="Primary"> bar. LEFT: the circular logo holder (reuse the existing .header-logo span + the HeaderLogo /logo.png-with-SVG-fallback component and its LogoMark fallback, moved verbatim from src/components/Header.tsx) and the app title <h1 className="header-title"> with text 'II-CCSAD || Class To-Do Board'. TABS: the three real <button>s (Board / Absences / Reviewers) wired to useNav().setPage with aria-current="page" on the active tab, carried in a .topbar-tabs container, using the existing tabStyle/activeTabStyle inline styles from Nav.tsx. Preserve the officer-only Absences pending badge EXACTLY as Nav.tsx renders it today (useAbsencePendingCount(isOfficer) from src/data/useAbsencePendingCount, isOfficer from useSession; badge hidden for non-officers or count<=0; same inline badge styles with var(--status-pending)/var(--status-pending-fg)). RIGHT: exactly one <AccountControls />. Give the outer <nav> className="topbar" and keep token-driven colors (var(--surface)/var(--text)/var(--border)) inline consistent with the current Nav/Header.

Edit src/App.tsx: replace the import and render of Nav with TopBar — `import { TopBar } from './components/TopBar';` and render <TopBar /> above <PageRouter /> inside NavProvider. Update the file-head comment to describe the single TopBar.

Edit src/components/Layout.tsx: remove the `<Header />` render (the second stacked bar) and the `import { Header } from './Header';` line, and update the Layout file-head comment to drop the mention of rendering the Header.

Add responsive bar CSS to src/styles/base.css extending the existing .header-* pattern: `.topbar` (display:flex, align-items:center, justify-content:space-between, flex-wrap:wrap, gap, padding 0.5rem 1rem, border-bottom 1px solid var(--border), background var(--surface), color var(--text)); `.topbar-tabs` (display:flex, align-items:center, gap, min-width:0). At max-width:640px make .topbar-tabs wrap to its own full-width line (flex-basis:100%, order after the brand/account) so tabs stay visible and tappable with no horizontal overflow; the existing .header-title display:none at <=640px still collapses the title. Verify no horizontal scroll at 320px. All colors stay tokenized.
Delete the now-unused src/components/Nav.tsx and src/components/Header.tsx, and confirm no remaining imports reference './Nav' or './Header' anywhere in src.

Update tests to the single-bar structure WITHOUT weakening behavior/accessibility assertions: src/components/Header.test.tsx already renders <AccountControls /> (not Header) and should still pass; adjust it only if it imports from './Header'. Add src/components/TopBar.test.tsx that mocks ../context/NavProvider (useNav), ../context/SessionProvider (useSession), and ../data/useAbsencePendingCount following the mock style in Header.test.tsx / Nav usage, asserting: the three tabs render as role=button; the active tab has aria-current='page'; the <nav> exposes aria-label='Primary' (getByRole('navigation', { name: 'Primary' })); the Absences pending badge appears for isOfficer with count>0 and is absent for a member or count 0; AccountControls renders exactly once (e.g. exactly one 'Appearance settings' button).
acceptance_criteria: Every page (board, absences, reviewers) shows exactly ONE top bar and exactly ONE AccountControls cluster — no stacked second bar on the board page.

The single bar contains logo + title (left), Board/Absences/Reviewers tabs with aria-current on the active one and aria-label='Primary' on the nav, the officer-only Absences pending badge preserved identically, and AccountControls (once) on the right.
On narrow screens (<=640px) the title collapses and the tabs remain visible and tappable with no horizontal page overflow at 320px.
src/components/Nav.tsx and src/components/Header.tsx are deleted with no dangling imports.
No colors are hardcoded; all come from tokens. focus-visible ring, sr-only patterns, and prefers-reduced-motion handling are unchanged.
`npm run test` passes with the new TopBar tests and no reduction in existing a11y/behavior assertions (>=168 passing).
verification: Run `npm run typecheck` in c:\Users\paulc\Projects\ToDoS\.worktrees\nav-redesign and confirm it exits 0.
Run `npm run test` in the worktree and confirm all tests pass including src/components/TopBar.test.tsx.
Run `npm run build` in the worktree and confirm it succeeds (a dangling Nav/Header import would fail the build).
findings: Done. New component src/components/TopBar.tsx exports `function TopBar()` (no props) — import as `import { TopBar } from './components/TopBar'`. Rendered once in App.tsx inside NavProvider, above PageRouter. HeaderLogo + LogoMark were moved verbatim into TopBar.tsx (not shared) and Header.tsx/Nav.tsx are deleted. Class names FEAT-002 can rely on: outer nav has className='topbar'; the tabs live in a `.topbar-tabs` container; the brand still uses `.header-logo` + `.header-title`; AccountControls still uses the existing `.header-auth-*`/`.header-account-name` classes. Token-driven colors (var(--surface)/var(--text)/var(--border)) are set inline on the <nav>; the .topbar/.topbar-tabs rules in base.css own layout + responsive collapse only (no colors). Responsive: at <=640px .header-title collapses (unchanged rule) and .topbar-tabs becomes order:1, flex-basis:100%, justify-content:center, flex-wrap:wrap so tabs drop to a full-width line below brand/account with no horizontal overflow at 320px; the <nav> itself is flex-wrap:wrap. Preserved exactly: aria-label='Primary', aria-current='page' on active tab, officer-only Absences badge (useAbsencePendingCount(isOfficer) + isOfficer from useSession, var(--status-pending)/-fg, hidden for non-officers or count<=0), one <AccountControls />, HeaderLogo /logo.png-with-SVG fallback, tabStyle/activeTabStyle inline styles. Tests: added src/components/TopBar.test.tsx (7 tests, mocks NavProvider/SessionProvider/useAbsencePendingCount + stubs supabase for AccountControls); Header.test.tsx already imported ./AccountControls so it was left untouched. Verification from worktree root: typecheck exit 0, test = 175 passed / 17 skipped (was 168), build succeeded.
